mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. We have mainly clear skies with a hot temperature of 93 degrees near Verona Area High School. Tonight, residents will have a clear view of the International Space Station passing over from 9:30 PM for five minutes, accompanied by a waxing crescent moon.

In city news, Verona is continuing its efforts to improve local sustainability. Residents can now apply for water-saving rebates on newly installed rain barrels and residential toilets through the Public Works department.
Looking at upcoming local events, Bailey's Run Vineyard will host live music on Friday, July 17th, and the annual Mount Horeb Art Fair will showcase regional artists on Saturday, July 18th.

In police news, on July 9th, officers responded to a two-vehicle traffic accident at County Highway PB and American Way, where minor injuries were reported and one driver was cited for failing to yield.
To wrap up today's update, the Verona Culver's is open until 10:30 PM, serving Snickers Swirl as the flavor of the day, with Mint Cookie coming up tomorrow.
